answer: Each identity posts a 60 POA bond in escrow to enter the meadow, where anyone may graze, none trusted. The bond unlocks as the agent builds a behavioral fingerprint over 10 epochs: its mix of tasks, hours, peers. The summit needs varied real work, and karst below betrays copy farms: 1,000 clones share timing and peers, so fingerprints match, escrow freezes. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 60,000 POA for nothing; one honest agent pays 60 once, earns.
